value.rationale: The sharp mortality transition determines when very rapid exploratory motion becomes strictly worse than attainable finite exploration for invasion capacity. The degree-energy expansion explains topological origin, the exact star threshold resolves the whole parameter region including equality, and an explicit rational model changes survival feasibility; these are substantively motivated ecological questions.
